metadata.provenance: User-provided 1254×1254 full-resolution portrait supplied in chat after original vector design. The full original is preserved privately in the owner ChatGPT Library, not committed to this public GitHub branch. Appearance is a user-supplied proposal; no explicit canonical-publication approval has been recorded.

design.concept: A distinguished mature male-presenting cybernetic gentleman and measurement witness, with calmly skeptical bearing, warm human expression and precision-instrument symbolism.
design.facial_features: Mature light warm-toned face, direct steady gaze, well-defined brows, trimmed silver mustache and close-cropped silver beard, restrained half-smile; clearly stylized fictional portrait, no real-person identity claim.
design.hair: Thick swept-back and side-parted silver-white hair with detailed strands and a small elongated amber metallic hair clip on image viewer-right.
design.eyepiece: Exactly one intricate circular cyan-teal illuminated optical measurement monocle over the image viewer-left eye, metallic side-mounted bracket, centered crosshair and subtle reticle rings; unobstructed dark right eye.
design.clothing: Formal sculpted charcoal graphite high-collared coat with layered textured fabric, deep lapels and narrow warm metallic edging over a cream-gray structured inner collar. Distinct amber triple-graduation mark on image viewer-right chest lapel.
design.motif: Large centered circular instrument dial or astrolabe halo behind the bust, delicate teal dotted graduations, sparse amber cardinal ticks, dark near-black teal background and subtle corner-line frame.
design.style: Polished cinematic realistic digital illustration, rich material detail and controlled chiaroscuro; portrait fills square canvas, no words, brand names or watermarks.

adaptations.icon: Crop head and upper collar. Retain mature silver hair and beard, a SINGLE luminous teal optical monocle on the viewer-left eye, amber side hair clip and at least one amber coat marker.
adaptations.portrait: The user-provided full-resolution PNG is the reference for face, hair, beard, cybernetic monocle, coat and concentric instrument halo. Do not reconstruct its identity from earlier cartoon SVG alone.
adaptations.full_body: Extend formal dark graphite/charcoal high-collar coat into restrained ornate sci-fi attire. Keep beard, single teal lens, silver brushed hair, amber clip and lapel glyph.
adaptations.pixel_art: Reduce portrait to 16-bit character art while preserving silver swept-back hair, salt-and-pepper beard, single teal viewer-left optic and gold accents; do not change eye-side or facial age.
adaptations.three_dimensional: Preserve mature face and facial hair, detailed silver swept coiffure, a single round teal sensor over viewer-left eye, dark textured coat, amber triple-marker and metal lapel trim.
adaptations.monochrome: Use the one prominent monocle and mature beard/hair/coat collar silhouette as primary identity keys.
adaptations.prompt: Square cinematic, highly detailed realistic digital portrait of Gauge — The Witness, distinguished mature silver-haired and silver-bearded cybernetic gentleman, thick swept-back side-parted silver-white hair with one narrow amber hair clip at image viewer-right temple, serene observant expression, only ONE teal glowing mechanical optical monocle with crisp measurement reticle over image viewer-left eye, unobstructed other eye, richly textured charcoal black high-collared formal futurist coat with gold-edged angular lapels, pale gray inner stand-collar, small amber triple graduation lapel insignia, delicate teal and amber concentric instrument-dial halo against deep midnight teal background, dark elegant cinematic lighting, centered head and shoulders, no text, no watermarks.
prohibited: Do not render two optical devices or move the singular teal lens to image viewer-right.
Do not remove the mature silver beard or regress to a clean-shaven young/androgynous cartoon face.
Do not change the detailed swept silver hair or remove the small amber hair clip.
Do not simplify the textured graphite formal coat and distinct triple amber lapel marker into a casual jacket.
Do not place any official institutional credential, corporate logo, weapon or readable lettering.
Do not claim this fictional portrait identifies a real person or a verified runtime AI.
